blocked.name: Shadow of the Enemy
blocked.why: exile-graveyard (all creature cards from target player's graveyard) has no mayCast/spendAs permission; only single-target `exile` and impulse-exile carry one

blocked.name: Breaking of the Fellowship
blocked.why: second target must be "another target creature that player controls" (same controller as slot 0); no target-spec constraint for that

blocked.name: Fires of Mount Doom
blocked.why: "When you play a card this way, ~ deals 2 damage to each player" needs a delayed trigger linked to the impulse-exiled card; plays-card only filters by zone

blocked.name: Esquire of the King
blocked.why: activated `costReduction` has no condition — "costs {2} less to activate if you control a legendary creature" can't be gated

blocked.name: Bill Ferny, Bree Swindler
blocked.why: mode 2 "remove Bill Ferny from combat" has no effect kind (and its "if they do" after a control change)

blocked.name: Rangers of Ithilien
blocked.why: gain control "for as long as you control this creature" (only whileSource = while on battlefield exists) of a creature "with lesser power" than the source (no source-relative power target filter)

blocked.name: Fealty to the Realm
blocked.why: "The monarch controls enchanted creature" — controlEnchanted gives control only to the Aura's controller; also "can't attack you" on the enchanted creature

blocked.name: Gandalf, Westward Voyager
blocked.why: each opponent reveals their top card; "if any of those cards shares a card type with that spell" copy it and each opponent draws, else you draw — no condition over revealed cards vs the trigger spell

blocked.name: Fell Beast's Shriek
blocked.why: Splice onto instant or sorcery isn't modeled (also "each opponent chooses a creature they control. Tap and goad the chosen creatures")

blocked.name: Barrow-Blade
blocked.why: 'Whenever equipped creature blocks ... a creature, that creature loses all abilities': the blocks trigger's object is the blocker; the blocked attacker isn't reachable

blocked.name: Witch-king, Bringer of Ruin
blocked.why: 'sacrifices a creature with the least power among creatures they control': only greatestAmongItsController exists, no least

blocked.name: Radagast the Brown
blocked.why: 'a creature card that doesn't share a creature type with a creature you control': sharesCreatureTypeWith reads only the trigger object

blocked.name: Frodo, Sauron's Bane
blocked.why: second ability 'becomes a Halfling Rogue' sets creature types without touching P/T; animate always sets base P/T (the granted Ring trigger and ring-tempted condition exist)

blocked.name: Fear, Fire, Foes!
blocked.why: 'Damage can't be prevented this turn' as a one-shot, turn-long effect has no vocabulary (the X plus 1-to-each-other-creature-of-that-controller part is expressible)

blocked.name: Gollum, Scheming Guide
blocked.why: an opponent guesses land/nonland for the top card, and 'remove Gollum from combat' has no effect

blocked.name: Isildur's Fateful Strike
blocked.why: 'they exile cards from their hand equal to the difference': no effect for the target's controller exiling N cards of their choice from hand (castOnlyIf covers the legendary-instant restriction)

blocked.name: Long List of the Ents
blocked.why: each chapter notes a creature type not yet noted for this Saga, then a delayed 'next creature spell of that type this turn enters with an additional +1/+1 counter'

blocked.name: Gimli, Mournful Avenger
blocked.why: 'When this ability resolves for the third time this turn, Gimli fights...': no count of an ability's resolutions per turn

blocked.name: Sharkey, Tyrant of the Shire
blocked.why: gains opponents' lands' nonmana activated abilities, stops those being activated, and spends mana as any type for its own: none expressible

blocked.name: Bewitching Leechcraft
blocked.why: granted 'if this creature would untap during your untap step, remove a +1/+1 counter from it instead; if you do, untap it': no such untap replacement

blocked.name: Sorcerous Squall
blocked.why: 'cast an instant or sorcery spell from that player's graveyard' after the mill: cast-now's from 'graveyard' is only the caster's own, and the card isn't a target

blocked.name: Elrond of the White Council
blocked.why: "For each fellowship vote, the voter chooses a creature they control" — a choice the voter makes after the vote; the secret vote itself is built.

blocked.name: Courageous Resolve
blocked.why: 'gains protection from each of your opponents until end of turn': protection is a static of colours/types/filters only, no temporary grant and no from-player (the fateful-hour half is expressible via player-effect)

blocked.name: Witch-king, Sky Scourge
blocked.why: X is the total power of the attacking Wraiths (last-known if gone, per its ruling); attack-with exposes no amount over its batch, and an attacking-filter aggregate is the drift AUTHORING section 15 forbids

blocked.name: Gandalf of the Secret Fire
blocked.why: exile the resolving spell with three time counters and give it suspend instead of the graveyard: exile-spell-as-it-resolves has return/plotted variants only

blocked.name: Denethor, Stone Seer
blocked.why: 'Target player becomes the monarch': become-monarch takes only a scope

blocked.name: Tale of Tinúviel
blocked.why: Chapter I: indestructible 'for as long as you control this Saga'. while-source ends only when the Saga leaves, not when control of it changes

blocked.name: Smite the Deathless
blocked.why: "If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead" — a replacement on the target for the turn; losing indestructible is built.

blocked.name: You Cannot Pass!
blocked.why: Target filter 'blocked or was blocked by a legendary creature this turn' needs a per-turn block history, with the partner read as it was when the block happened (the ruling)

blocked.name: Aragorn, Company Leader
blocked.why: 'Whenever you put one or more counters on Aragorn, put one of each of those kinds on up to one other target creature': nothing gives the trigger the set of kinds just put. The first ability's choice of counter is also made on resolution

blocked.name: Glorfindel, Dauntless Rescuer
blocked.why: Mode 2 'can't be blocked by more than one creature each combat this turn' exists only as a static (blockedByAtMostOne), not as a one-shot grant until end of turn. The restrict effect's CombatRestriction union has no such entry

blocked.name: Shagrat, Loot Bearer
blocked.why: 'Amass Orcs X, where X is the number of Equipment attached to Shagrat': no amount or filter counts the Equipment attached to the source

blocked.name: Rally the Galadhrim
blocked.why: Conspire (rule 702.78) isn't modelled

blocked.name: Éowyn, Lady of Rohan
blocked.why: "Equip abilities you activate cost {1} less": abilityCostModification has ninjutsu/unlock flags but no equip-only one (the begin-combat trigger itself is expressible).

blocked.name: Saruman of Many Colors
blocked.why: Ward—Discard an enchantment, instant, or sorcery card: WardCost.discard is a count with no card filter; its second-spell trigger's reflexive 'milled this way' exile-and-cast capped by that spell's mana value is unverified too.

blocked.name: King of the Oathbreakers
blocked.why: "Whenever ~ or another Spirit you control phases in": no phase-in trigger (AUTHORING §15, rule 603.10b).

blocked.name: Landroval, Horizon Witness
blocked.why: "Whenever two or more creatures you control attack a player": attacks-player fires once per player but has no attacker-count threshold, and attack-with counts the whole declaration, not per player.

blocked.name: Battle-Scarred Goblin
blocked.why: "Deals 1 damage to each creature blocking it": no filter/scope for the creatures blocking a given attacker (only blocking: true, any blocker).

blocked.name: Lobelia, Defender of Bag End
blocked.why: "{T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Choose one —": a modal activated ability (modes chosen on activation, rule 602.2b/700.2) isn't built (AUTHORING §15 'Modal abilities').

blocked.name: Mists of Lórien
blocked.why: Replicate {U} isn't built (no vocabulary); 'each other nonland permanent with the same mana value as that permanent' would also need a filter keyed to the target's mana value.

blocked.name: Mirkwood Trapper
blocked.why: "Whenever a player attacks, if they aren't attacking you, that player chooses an attacking creature": no per-declaration trigger with a 'not attacking you (planeswalkers aside)' condition, and the attacking player makes an untargeted choice. (The first ability, attacks-player defender you, is expressible.)

blocked.name: Surrounded by Orcs
blocked.why: 'mills X cards, where X is the amassed Army's power': amass exposes no reference to the Army it chose

blocked.name: Call for Aid
blocked.why: gain-control-all can't name a target player's creatures (controlledBy is trigger-player only); 'those creatures' (untap, haste, can't be sacrificed this turn) needs a this-way set of what changed control; and 'you can't attack that player this turn' has no effect

blocked.name: Rampaging War Mammoth
blocked.why: 'When you cycle this card, destroy up to X target artifacts': a target count of X (from the cycling cost) isn't expressible

blocked.name: Archivist of Gondor
blocked.why: 'if there is no monarch' has no condition (monarch is only who: you | opponent), and 'at the beginning of the monarch's end step, that player draws' has no step trigger keyed to the monarch
